title: Days, Weeks, Years and Longer Time Units
introduction: Explore days, weeks, years and longer time units using everyday examples.
definition: A day has 24 hours, a week has seven days and a year has twelve months. A decade contains 10 years, a century 100 and a millennium 1,000. Months differ in length; do not assume each is four weeks.

examples.question: Convert 3 decades and 5 years to years.
